SUBJECT: MN25102 HUMAN VALUES AND PROFESSIONAL ETHICS
TIME:02 Hours  FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1(a) Discuss the importance of human values in our life.? [2] 1 1
Q.1(b) What is the concept of civic virtue. Give some examples of civic virtue that You practice
in everyday life.?
[3] 1 2

want to be”. Explain suitably.?
[3] 1 3

Q.4(b) Distinguish between the needs of the self and the needs of the body.? [3] 2 1
